guestBioOfficial.en: Rahul Vohra is the founder and CEO of Superhuman. Prior to Superhuman, Rahul founded Rapportive, the first Gmail plug-in to scale to millions of users, which he sold to LinkedIn in 2012. He is also a prominent angel investor, and his fund has invested $50 million in over 120 companies, including Placer, Supabase, Mercury, Zip, ClassDojo, and Writer. What you’ll learn:
guestBioOfficial.zh: 拉胡尔·沃赫拉是Superhuman的创始人兼CEO。在创立Superhuman之前，拉胡尔创立了Rapportive，这是首款扩展至数百万用户的Gmail插件，并于2012年将其出售给LinkedIn。他还是一位著名的天使投资人，其基金已向Placer、Supabase、Mercury、Zip、ClassDojo和Writer等120多家公司投资5000万美元。你将学到：

title.en: Superhuman's secret to success | Rahul Vohra (CEO and founder)
title.zh: 《超人成功秘诀》| 拉胡尔·沃赫拉（CEO兼创始人）

summary.en: Rahul reveals that there is no such thing as a truly viral product - only word-of-mouth and remarkability - and that great products deliberately ignore much early feedback to serve a narrow, passionate wedge. He shares his 'switch log' technique for reclaiming time from calendar tyranny, his long-time Transcendental Meditation practice, and why he hired a president to offload operations. The episode is a masterclass in deliberate, taste-driven building.
summary.zh: Rahul 揭示：并不存在真正“病毒式”的产品——有的只是口碑与“值得被谈论（remarkability）”，而伟大的产品会刻意忽略大量早期反馈，只为服务一个狭窄而狂热的小切口。他分享了自己挣脱日历暴政的“切换日志（switch log）”技巧、长期的超觉冥想（TM）练习，以及为何聘请一位总裁来卸下运营重担。本期是一堂关于刻意、凭品味驱动的建设的大师课。
